conditions: Tatoeba states that the textual sentence exports are released under CC BY 2.0 FR and permits reuse, modification, and redistribution with attribution.
Credit the sentence authors, identify Tatoeba as the source, link the license, and identify the tokenization, filtering, deduplication, splitting, and statistical aggregation as changes.
Distribute derived dictionaries and language-model assets under CC BY 2.0 FR with the contributor attribution files; do not distribute source sentence text in the production package.

preprocessing_policy.sentence_family_split: SHA-256 of source/base sentence ID, deterministic 80/10/10; translations with the same source remain in one split
preprocessing_policy.filters: 2 to 40 tokens; language-specific runtime tokenizer and normalization; NFC; deduplicate identical normalized sentences
preprocessing_policy.attribution: one sorted contributor-name list per language, derived from training sentences only
preprocessing_policy.known_limitations: Tatoeba is community-contributed sentence material and includes translations; official guidance warns that some sentences may be unnatural or need correction. Validation/test measures performance only on this source domain.

considered_alternatives.name: Mozilla Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0
considered_alternatives.decision: Not selected: these are ASR scripted-speech archives with large audio payloads, and the domain is read prompts rather than general written text. The CC0 license is permissive, but the dataset shape is a poorer fit than Tatoeba's text-only language-tool export.

considered_alternatives.name: CoRoLa Reference Corpus of Contemporary Romanian
considered_alternatives.license_or_access: Public query interfaces; source site says the corpus is not available for download, in whole or in part.
considered_alternatives.decision: Not selected: the model-training workflow requires a downloadable text corpus.
